parties: CtrlS Datacenters Ltd. (Hyderabad) / Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments)
headline: CPP Investments commits C$1 billion to CtrlS for equity stake and hyperscale datacenter joint venture in India
sum: Strategic partnership combining equity investment and joint venture for AI-ready datacenter expansion. CPP Investments invests ₹4,000 crore (C$588 million) for an 8.2% stake at a pre-money valuation of ₹44,914 crore, with a further ₹3,000 crore (C$441 million) committed to a joint venture where CPP will hold 48% and CtrlS 52% ownership.
implication: Cross-border infrastructure JV marks first institutional capital raise for CtrlS; signals global pension capital's confidence in India's hyperscale datacenter buildout and poses precedent for dual-structure equity-plus-JV deals in digital infrastructure.
detail: <cite index="25-7,25-8">This is CtrlS's first fundraise from an institutional player; prior funding came from family and friends.</cite> <cite index="25-1">The deal values CtrlS at a pre-money valuation of $4.7 billion.</cite> <cite index="25-13,25-14,25-15">The ₹4,000 crore equity will fund capacity building; the company currently has 1.2 GW under construction and 3 GW+ in planning stages with land and power secured.</cite> <cite index="10-3">CtrlS has signed definitive agreements</cite>, marking deal completion.
